form.name: Name
form.no_agents: No agent in this profile can take a prompt.

options.title: Run options
options.missed_hint: If the hub was not running at its time, it runs once when the hub is back within 24 hours. Off, it never runs late, and the history says so.
options.overlap: If the previous run is still going
options.overlap_hint: “Run now” always starts at once and stops nothing.
options.skip_hint: This time does not run, and the history says so.
options.wait_hint: Runs as soon as the previous run ends. Only one time waits.
options.parallel_hint: Runs in a new conversation next to the previous one.
options.replace_hint: Stops the previous run, then starts.
options.hermes: Hermes decides these two for its own jobs, so they are not set here.

hermes.unreachable: Hermes is not answering right now, so nothing was changed.
hermes.timezone: Hermes runs every cron in {zone}. Use that zone, or change Hermes's timezone.
hermes.delivery: Hermes posts to messaging platforms itself — ask for it in the prompt.
hermes.prompt_required: A schedule for Hermes needs a prompt.
hermes.fired: Hermes will run it on its next tick.
hermes.run_options: Hermes decides the run options for its own jobs, so they are not set here.

history.title: History
history.waiting: Waiting for the previous run to end

jobs.note: What runs on its own for this agent in this profile. For Hermes these are the jobs in its own scheduler. Make or edit one on the Schedules page.
jobs.none_body: Nothing is scheduled for this agent in this profile. Make a schedule on the Schedules page and it shows here.
jobs.delete_body: It is deleted from Hermes's scheduler too.
